info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Referrals-v2-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Referral API provides access to referral information for job applications. This API allows recruiters and HR professionals to retrieve details about the referrals submitted for various job positions. It serves as a valuable resource for monitoring referral activity and enhancing the recruitment process. Typical consumers include hiring managers and recruitment software integrators seeking to optimize candidate sourcing through referrals.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch a list of referral applications, including relevant details and statuses. It provides an efficient way to access all submissions related to referrals.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving referral applications. Provide necessary parameters in the request body as specified in the schema.

202.description: Request has been accepted and is currently being processed.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsRequest.description: This schema represents a request body for an application referral operation in the GET method.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsResponse.title: Referral Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the application processed successfully.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the application.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the application.

state.description: The current state of the application.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the application, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the application processing.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the application.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsResponse.description: This schema represents the response for a referral application operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information about the audit of an application.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
